get.description: Detailed health check endpoint with service statuses.

schema.title: Response Liveness Check Health Live Get

get.description: Readiness probe - checks if the app can serve traffic.

schema.title: Response Readiness Check Health Ready Get

get.description:
List non-deleted programs, optionally narrowed by query-string filters.
Repeated params (``category_id``, ``team_size``, ``commitment_frequency``,
``commitment_duration``) are OR-ed within a group and AND-ed across groups.
When ``lat``/``lng`` are supplied, each program carries ``distance_km`` —
the straight-line distance from the caller to its location.

Programs the caller is part of, backing My Page's "My programs" list.

A program qualifies when the caller holds an active (pending/approved)
participation, or created it before creator auto-enrolment existed and so
holds no participation row at all — a withdrawn row means they left on
purpose (mirrors ``_creator_has_row``). Soft-deleted programs are excluded.
Rows carry the same capacity/banner enrichment as ``GET /programs``.

schema.title: Response List My Programs Me Programs Get

get.description:
Programs the caller has bookmarked, backing the Bookmarks tab. Soft-deleted
programs are excluded; rows carry the same capacity/banner enrichment as
``GET /programs`` and are ordered soonest-first to match the client list.

schema.title: Response List My Bookmarks Me Bookmarks Get

post.description:
Bookmark a program for the caller. Idempotent — re-bookmarking is a no-op.
404 if the program doesn't exist (or is soft-deleted).

delete.description:
Remove the caller's bookmark. Idempotent — removing a missing one is a
no-op (so the client can clear a bookmark even after the program is gone).

patch.description:
Partial update of a program. Only fields set in ``payload`` are touched.
Host-only: returns 403 if the caller isn't the program's creator.

delete.description:
Soft-delete a program. Sets ``is_deleted=True`` so it stops appearing in
feeds (``_load_program`` filters them out) while keeping the row for audit
and participation history. Host-only.

schema.title: Response List Program Keywords Programs  Program Id  Keywords Get

get.description:
Active participants of a program with the profile fields the Members row
renders (name + avatar), oldest join first. Public, like the profile and
keyword sub-resources. The host appears here only when they hold a row; the
detail screen draws the host separately from ``creator_user_id``.

schema.title: Response List Participants Programs  Program Id  Participants Get

get.description:
One "nearby" program to suggest on the detail screen.

Picked server-side so the client never pulls whole tables: each strategy is a
bounded ``LIMIT 1`` query. Prefers the geographically nearest program (when
coordinates exist), then the same city, region, category, and finally any
other program. ``distance_km`` is set only for the coordinate-based match.

Capacity snapshot for the Join counter, including whether the caller has
already joined.

post.description:
Join the program as the authenticated user, returning the refreshed
capacity snapshot. Rejects joins when the program isn't open, is at
capacity, or the caller has already joined.

delete.description: Withdraw the authenticated user's participation, freeing their slot.

schema.title: Response List Program Posts Programs  Program Id  Posts Get

post.description: Open a new question on the program's Member board.

schema.title: Response List Post Comments Programs  Program Id  Posts  Post Id  Comments Get

post.description: Add a comment, or a reply when ``parent_comment_id`` is supplied.

Like a comment (idempotent — re-liking is a no-op). Returns the comment
with its refreshed like state.

delete.description:
Remove the caller's like (idempotent). Returns the comment with its
refreshed like state.

schema.title: Response List User Interests Users  User Id  Interests Get

get.description: The profile-interest catalog — the chips on the signup interests step.

post.description:
Find-or-create a location. Reuses an existing row when city, state and
country match case-insensitively (backfilling missing coordinates), so the
table doesn't accumulate duplicates as users pick places on the map.
Return a presigned PUT URL for uploading an image to Cloudflare R2.

AuthResponse.title: AuthResponse
AuthResponse.description: Wire shape matching iOS `AuthResponse` ({ token, user }).

CommitmentDuration.title: CommitmentDuration
CommitmentDuration.description:
Expected length of commitment in months, as filter buckets (wire values
match iOS CommitmentDuration).

CommitmentFrequency.title: CommitmentFrequency
CommitmentFrequency.description: How often a program expects volunteers to show up (wire values match iOS).

ForumCommentCreate.title: ForumCommentCreate
ForumCommentCreate.description: Payload to add a comment, or a reply when ``parent_comment_id`` is set.

ForumCommentRead.title: ForumCommentRead
ForumCommentRead.description:
Wire shape matching iOS `ForumComment`.

``parent_comment_id`` carries the reply threading; ``like_count`` and
``liked_by_me`` are computed per request (not stored on the row), so they
default here and the router fills them in.

ForumPostCreate.title: ForumPostCreate
ForumPostCreate.description: Payload to open a new question on a program's Member board.

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description: Health check response with detailed service statuses.

LocationCreate.title: LocationCreate
LocationCreate.description:
Body for ``POST /locations`` — find-or-create a location picked on the
client's map. Matching is case-insensitive on city/state/country.

ProgramCreate.title: ProgramCreate
ProgramCreate.description:
Create payload for a new program. The creator is taken from the caller's
auth token, and ``location_id`` falls back to the first known location when
omitted (the client's free-text region picker isn't mapped to a location
row yet).

ProgramParticipantRead.title: ProgramParticipantRead
ProgramParticipantRead.description:
A program participant with the profile fields the Members row renders
(name + avatar). A subset of iOS `UserProfile`, so it decodes into the same
model client-side.

ProgramParticipationSummary.title: ProgramParticipationSummary
ProgramParticipationSummary.description:
Capacity snapshot for a program from the caller's perspective, used by the
iOS detail screen to render the Join counter and gate the Join button.

ProgramStatus.title: ProgramStatus
ProgramStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a program (wire values match iOS ProgramStatus).

ProgramUpdate.title: ProgramUpdate
ProgramUpdate.description:
Partial update body for ``PATCH /programs/{program_id}``. Every field is
optional; only fields explicitly set are applied. The caller must be the
program's creator (enforced in the route).

RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest
RegisterRequest.description: Sign-up payload: creates a `User` plus its `UserProfile`.

SimilarProgramRead.title: SimilarProgramRead
SimilarProgramRead.description:
A single "nearby" suggestion for the program detail screen, picked
server-side with a bounded ``LIMIT 1`` query. ``distance_km`` is the
straight-line distance from the source program when both have coordinates,
else ``None`` (the match was made by city/region/category).

TeamSize.title: TeamSize
TeamSize.description:
Team-size preference buckets used as a `GET /programs` filter. Not stored
on the program; mapped to ``max_volunteers`` ranges at query time (wire
values match iOS TeamSize).

UserInterestDetail.title: UserInterestDetail
UserInterestDetail.description: A user's interest joined with its keyword name, for the profile screen.

UserProfileRead.title: UserProfileRead
UserProfileRead.description:
Wire shape matching iOS `UserProfile`.

Interests are embedded here (rather than served from a separate
``/me/interests`` resource) so a single profile read hydrates the whole
screen and caches as one object.

UserProfileUpdate.title: UserProfileUpdate
UserProfileUpdate.description:
Partial update for the signed-in user's profile (`PATCH /me/profile`).

Every field is optional; only fields explicitly present in the request body
are written, so a client can update a single field without clobbering the
rest. Use ``model_dump(exclude_unset=True)`` to honour that contract.

``interest_keyword_ids`` folds the interest write into the same request: when
present it replaces the user's whole interest set; when omitted the existing
interests are left untouched.
